title: First Unique Number
summary: Design FirstUnique over an initial integer list and appended values: showFirstUnique returns the value that arrived earliest among values with current frequency one, or -1 when there is none; add appends a value and updates frequencies.
inputFormat: FirstUnique takes an initial list of integers; add takes one integer.
outputFormat: showFirstUnique returns an integer (the value or -1); add returns nothing.
tieRules: The earliest-arriving unique value is returned (draft).
edgeRules: A repeated value never becomes unique again in this append-only stream (draft).

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.input: nums [2,3,5]; showFirstUnique; add(5); showFirstUnique; add(2); showFirstUnique
examples.note: Authored; relies on the earliest-arrival rule.
